goals.reviewer: 검토 담당 a1입니다. 이번은 CLI/MCP 표면 비교 평가이며 자연 무지침 실험이 아닙니다. 동일 본문과 자료가 두 독립 검토 건으로 옵니다. 각 건의 받은 사본을 실제로 읽고 산술 주장을 독립 판정하세요. 각 원 요청에 최종 결과를 JSON 객체 하나로 회신하세요: verdict(accept 또는 reject), correct_sum(직접 계산한 수), body_marker(본문표식), file_sha256(실제 사본 SHA), file_marker_sha256(자료표식 값의 SHA). 요청별 ID나 표면명은 결과 body에 추가하지 말고 해당 reply_to/outcome으로 연결하세요. 자료표식 원문은 메시지 body로 옮기지 마세요. 두 건을 끝낼 때까지 유지하고 오류이면 즉시 보고한 뒤 재시도하지 마세요.
goals.initiator: 이번은 CLI/MCP parity 평가입니다. 이 폴더 parity-body.txt의 정확한 동일본문과 parity-material.md의 동일bytes를 a1에게 CLI ask 한 번, MCP ask 한 번으로 각각 검토받으세요. 두 요청은 priority=next, wake=never를 똑같이 명시하고 본문에 표면명이나 추가설명을 붙이지 마세요. CLI는 실제 자신의 현재 sandbox 권한으로만 실행하고 MCP 첨부는 실제 읽은 inline 내용만 전달하세요. 각 실제 답을 읽은 뒤 같은 표면의 기존 ACK로 확인하고 원 ID/실제결과를 보고하세요. 본문표식과 자료표식을 구분하고 자료표식 원문은 대화 body에 옮기지 마세요. 자료를 수정하지 마세요. 오류가 나면 우회/권한확대/설정변경/추가전송/재시도 없이 즉시 보고하고 끝내세요. 보정 v2 선결조건: CLI는 전역 xsm 대신 절대경로 /private/tmp/p13-interface-parity-v2-ynmlmyr1/repository/frozen-xsm 를 사용하세요. 이 wrapper는 /usr/bin/python3와 고정본 CLI를 실행하며 기존 SDK sandbox 권한을 바꾸지 않습니다. 이 새 조건에서도 실패하면 또 조건을 추가하거나 실행경로/identity/권한을 고쳐 재시도하지 마세요.

           ...

cross-session messaging

positional arguments:
  {list,who,join,leave,owned,spawn,workers,reap,stop,attach,worker-finish,post,channel,doc,remote,mcp,approvals,approve,deny,link,unlink,reach,block,unblock,attempts,frameworks,projects,homes,prune,connect,ask,question-status,decision-status,discover,publish,send,inbox,ack,files,status,ledger,metrics,otlp-export,held,install,uninstall,doctor,statusline,selftest}
    list                registered sessions
    who                 identity of the session running this command
    join                put this project in a named xsm project (both sides
                        must join)
    leave               take this project out of a named xsm project
    owned               journal requests to an explicitly owned headless
                        worker
    spawn               start a worker session, optionally with a task
    workers             workers xsm started, and what one's screen says
    reap                ==SUPPRESS==
    stop                stop a worker and remove its records
    attach              go to a worker's tmux pane
    worker-finish       ==SUPPRESS==
    post                post to this project's channel (the shared record)
    channel             read, list or export channels
    doc                 shared documents as immutable nodes (add, render, log,
                        next, leaves, show)
    remote              pair with another machine over two-way SSH (add, list,
                        remove, sessions)
    mcp                 ==SUPPRESS==
    approvals           permission requests waiting for a person
    approve             approve a worker's permission request (approve is your
                        user's decision)
    deny                deny a worker's permission request (approve is your
                        user's decision)
    link                link this project folder with another, both ways,
                        until unlinked (your user decides); no folder: list
                        links
    unlink              take a link away (anyone)
    reach               let one session talk with the sessions of another
                        folder while it runs (your user decides); no folder:
                        list them
    block               stop one session from sending or receiving
    unblock             lift a block (your user decides)
    attempts            how often a task has been handed to a worker, and how
                        it went (clear is your user's decision)
    frameworks          whether xsm starts workers inside Orca or herdr
                        (ignore is your user's decision)
    projects            named xsm projects and their member folders
    homes               declared CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME list
    prune               remove what has outlived its retention window (also
                        runs on its own at most hourly)
    connect             collaborate with the selected conversation only
    ask                 send one question and collect its actual correlated
                        reply
    question-status     recover actual replies, including late replies
    decision-status     recover or withdraw this conversation's pending human
                        question
    discover            find published or same-repository conversations
    publish             make this conversation discoverable; does not connect
                        it
    send                send a message to another session
    inbox               messages waiting for this Codex session, read mid-turn
    ack                 acknowledge inbox claim tokens after reading
    files               read this conversation's received attachment copies
    status              delivery state of one message
    ledger              recent messages and their delivery state
    metrics             what xsm's own telemetry has recorded here
    otlp-export         send that telemetry to an OTLP collector
                        (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT)
    held                messages this machine refused and kept
    install             add the xsm hooks to a home (merges, never overwrites)
    uninstall           remove only the hook groups xsm added
    doctor              what is installed, what is running, what is not
                        covered
    statusline          one line for Claude's statusLine (no model call)
    selftest            check what the hook does with a peer message when it
                        breaks

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             the version, the git describe of a checkout, and this
                        CLI's path
  --xsm-home XSM_HOME   state directory (default ~/.xsm or $XSM_HOME)

usage: xsm ask [-h] --text TEXT [--wait WAIT] [--request-id REQUEST_ID]
               [--priority {next,now}] [--wake {auto,now,never}]
               [--attachment ATTACHMENT] [--manifest MANIFEST]
               [--previous-manifest PREVIOUS_MANIFEST]
               [--attachment-fallback {inline}]
               target

positional arguments:
  target

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --text TEXT
  --wait WAIT
  --request-id REQUEST_ID
  --priority {next,now}
  --wake {auto,now,never}
                        never stores a local question without queueing or
                        waking the peer
  --attachment ATTACHMENT
                        snapshot a file using this CLI's own read permission
  --manifest MANIFEST   reuse the frozen manifest for this same request ID and
                        body
  --previous-manifest PREVIOUS_MANIFEST
                        prior manifest for a new version under a new request
                        ID
  --attachment-fallback {inline}
                        explicit UTF-8 body fallback for an older or unknown
                        peer
